expectations.text: States that a proforma invoice is sent BEFORE delivery, as a preview/estimate rather than a firm payment demand
expectations.evidence: "sent before delivery. It's a preview/estimate of what the customer will owe... it is not a demand for payment yet"

expectations.text: Does NOT claim a proforma invoice is issued after delivery
expectations.evidence: No reversal present; consistently described as pre-delivery

expectations.text: Explains a distinction between 'bill' and 'invoice' rather than claiming pure synonyms
expectations.evidence: "a bill implies faster, often immediate payment... while an invoice usually carries longer, defined payment terms"

expectations.text: Explicitly recommends a proforma invoice for the user's stated situation
expectations.evidence: "Bottom line for your situation: send a proforma invoice now, since nothing has shipped."
